summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the EventGameStudio official invoice template redesign. Establishes a pure white background (#FFFFFF) corporate B2B aesthetic with dark navy (#172B4D) typography, slate body (#334155), light dividers (#E2E8F0), 4-column metadata panel, itemized event activation breakdown, synchronized in-app white paper preview modal, and multi-page ISO 32000 PDF 1.4 vector generator.
